name: Arity-2 H-box as a phase gadget
summary: An arity-2 H-box with label $e^{iα}$ decomposes into Z-phases α/2 and a phase gadget with phase −α/2.
description:
An arity-2 H-box with label $e^{i\alpha}$ is the diagonal map that applies the phase $e^{i\alpha xy}$ to $|x,y\rangle$ (read as a state on two qubits it is a controlled phase gate applied to $|{+}{+}\rangle$). Using $xy = \frac{1}{2}(x + y - x\oplus y)$ this phase can be written with two Z-phases $\frac{\alpha}{2}$ and one [phase gadget](../phase-gadget-fusion/) with phase $-\frac{\alpha}{2}$ on the parity $x\oplus y$.

This is the simplest instance of the *graphical Fourier transform*, which turns any H-box with a phase label into phase gadgets; see the [arity-3 version](../zh-h-box-phase-gadget-3/).
notes: The H-boxes here are *unnormalised*: an H-box with label $a$ has all entries equal to $1$, except for the entry where all wires are $1$, which is $a$. The grey spiders of the ZH papers are normalised differently from the X-spiders of PyZX, so scalar factors may differ from those in the papers.
